title: Fixes
body: Generated links networks as symbols must be aligned by the grid, in this case we should fit exactly two columns of symbols per grid cell/column. Animated SVG of Unversal Problem Solving has problems with display of symbols, for example there is no visible `S` in `Solution`. Decompostion has overlap with arrow (link). We should double check everything is perfectly aligned in all places. `After the [original drawing](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/1d91e911-9ba4-456e-a00a-14cdd60d9a0a) by konard. Dimmed drafts are the experiments that did not pass their tests.` that is too verbose, we should just give link to original drawing and original idea repository. We also should explain that this recursive algorithm, which can be applied to itself allows to produce a plan, or even in algorithm if decomposition is deep enough and so on. We also need to deeply think about how this algorithm is actually useful and can be reused, so each word and each symbol deserve careful consideration. So everything is precise and as true as possible. With all notes, that once we understand that during solution implementation or solution search we need to change definition of a task, we go back to first stage and redo everything recursively, in real life it is rarely means redoing everything from scratch, but it actually means that this algorithm is fully recur-vice and self improving if we find out that for current description / formulation of the task the task will have no solutions that are resonable or appropriate. So it includes `making requirements less dumb` and so on. And we have actual implementation of this algorithm in the code at github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind, as well as in github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai. By clicking at links network in such sections we should be able to show random links network as per possible configurations, with math and links notation of links network. We should clearly state with small font what is math notation, and what is links notation in example in this section. Also visual of the links network itself is wrong. First of all the line continuity cannot be ever broken in the middle of a link. There must be no borders with the middle of the link, so it does not feel separate. We also should use different colors for each link, so they feel as distinct whole object, not some parts. The links that starts in itself and ends in itself must be symmetrical (not one sided like now). This is already closer to correct visual (yet even here link looks split in the middle, it must not be split in the middle visually). So when we use a self-referencing (fully closed) link with network of other links it must shaped closer to symmetrical 8, not one sided eyeglasses. For example self referenctial link here is closer to one sided eyeglasses, not to rotated vertically 8 (which should be correct symmetrical way to draw double self reference). Also second link's (right link) continuity is broken in the middle, so it does not look like whole object. We struggled alot to make it right at blueprint of github.com/konard/links-visuals, here we should do even better. Here is close to the expected result but not quite. We should preserve 0 as nothing or link from nothing and to nothing. So 0 links should be encoded as 00. When we have 1 link we have more options: So in this image we have 00 (this is permanent zero link) 00 (this is first real link, which points from nothing to nothing), to the right we have 00 11 (the link that has index 1 points to itself twice) 11 in binary 11_2 = (1: 1 1) in link notation. And at the bottom of this example we have 00 01 and 00 10. So when we have single link + emptyness, we have 00 - (just a link floating) 10 - (self starting link) 01 - (self ending link) 11 - (self referencing twice (starting and ending)). So we should redraw all the possibilities with 0 always assumed, and 1 means first real link. And so on. For 2, 3 and 4 real link we have lots of possibilities missing. And double check all graphics are done correctly and perfectly according to rules I described. In open-source ecosystem view we should not show organizations like: - https://github.com/EfficiencyParadigm - https://github.com/Qvinciy - https://github.com/Gls-full - https://github.com/links-games - https://github.com/open-online-tools - https://github.com/Svetozar-Technologies - https://github.com/meteor-shuttler As they don't present any value for viewer for now. We also should filter automatically empty repositories like https://github.com/konard/TheAnime Also exclude something the looks like broken forks - https://github.com/konard/slava (we should detect such). This is too much confusing, what `copies of client projects kept for history` it looks like I have stolen some private repository, as in really maximum we can have is public forks, and we should not present information about private repositories even if we have them. In menu we should have first CV, and after that Experience, and after that Repositories. In experience `all` we should also show all the repositories listed. Also Data-scientist should be instead of `Researcher` or just use `Scientist`. `Every configuration of 1–4 links` should also go to research, not just art and other. And we should show formula. For example for 1 link we use binary numbers from 00 to 11 (with superscript 00_2, 10_2, 01_2, 11_2 and so on). So all configurations of network a written as is meaning (1: 0 0) is 00_2, (1: 1 0) is 10_2 and so on. So each network is encoded as links exactly. Once we go to 2 links we have more configurations. 00_3 00_3 to 22_3 22_3 And all of them must be drawable. For 3 links we already use 4-th base system like this: 00_4 00_4 00_4 to 33_4 33_4 33_4 and so on. So we should have much more combinations, and all of them carefully drawable with most elegant and correct way. We need to download all logs and data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), in which we will reconstruct timeline/sequence of events, list of each and all requirements from the issue, find root causes of the each problem, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions). If there is not enough data to find actual root cause, add debug output and verbose mode if not present, that will allow us to find root cause on next iteration. If issue related to any other repository/project, where we can report issues on GitHub, please do so. Each issue must contain reproducible examples, workarounds and suggestions for fix the issue in code. Also double check to fully apply requirements to entire codebase, so if we have issue in multiple places, it should be fixed in all them. Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until it is each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
